name: Honda Rebel 1100
engine: 1,084 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected, manual or DCT
intro: The big Rebel, with the Africa Twin's twin engine. Some have Honda's DCT automatic gearbox.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Every 2021 Rebel 1100 was in recall 21V987 for the radiator cap, and some 2024-2025 bikes are in recall 25V358 for an engine oil leak. Book any open recall with a Honda dealer.
A-002.reason: Both repairs are free. A bad radiator cap can spray hot coolant.

A: Note whether yours is a manual or a DCT. Clutch and gearbox service is different for each.

recalls.what: Radiator cap may not seal and can leak or spray hot coolant.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the cap and refills coolant free (Honda KN1).
